title: Agent Resource Discovery Receipt
description: Receipt emitted when a resource is discovered, evaluated, and admitted (or rejected) into the Agent Resource Registry. Defines the governed discovery-to-admission flow per issue #1686. Each receipt binds a discovery event to evidence, an admission decision, a reviewer, and a timestamp. Receipts are append-only and referenced by registry entries via the discovery_receipts field.

resource_id.description: The registry entry this receipt applies to (must match an existing resource_id).

ref.description: Reference to the evidence (URL, commit SHA, PR number, doc path, test name, log line, etc.).

note.description: Optional context about what this evidence proves.

evidence.description: Evidence supporting the discovery and admission decision. At least one item required.

admission_decision.description: The decision made during this discovery event. admit = promote to namespace_status=admitted; reject = set namespace_status=rejected; hold = keep as candidate; retire = set namespace_status=retired.

reviewer.description: Who performed the review and made the admission decision. Must be an authorized authority class.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the admission decision (RFC3339, e.g. 2026-07-04T00:00:00Z).

notes.description: Optional context about the discovery or decision rationale.

rejection_reason.description: Required when admission_decision is reject or retire. Explains why the resource was not admitted.

receipt_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the canonical receipt (excluding the receipt_hash field) for tamper detection.
